technology_name: A CHARGE CARRIER-DIFFUSION BASED SELF-POWERED MICRODETECTOR BASED ON HAFNIUM DISULFIDE-SILVER HETEROSTRUCTURES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Microscale light sensors require heavy wiring and external biasing circuits that limit scaling density and generate internal thermal leakage currents.
description: An ultra-compact, self-powered microdetector layout fabricated by engineering a hafnium disulfide ($HfS_2$) and silver (Ag) heterostructure that generates stable photo-voltages upon light irradiation without any external supply.
applications: On-chip optical interconnects, micro-optoelectronic diagnostic arrays, autonomous micro-drone navigation sensors, and high-density fiber-optic telemetry receivers.
